heading: Repayment of principal

tree.heading: Currency of payment
tree.text: The principal amount owed under each new obligation issued under section 1738c of this title shall be repaid in United States dollars.

tree.heading: Deposit of payments
tree.text: Principal repayments on new obligations issued under section 1738c of this title shall be deposited in Commodity Credit Corporation accounts.

sourceCredit: (July 10, 1954, ch. 469, title VI, § 605, as added Pub. L. 101–624, title XV, § 1512, Nov. 28, 1990, 104 Stat. 3659.)
